action.objective: Verify a5b6: capture the b6 bishop, win material, and reduce Black's attacking pieces against White's exposed king.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search (3000 nodes) made a5b6 the exact top candidate at -80, well ahead of c2f2 (-224, upper bound) and king moves (-242 to -271). a5b6 wins the b6 bishop, and the PV shows axb6 d3xc2 Qxc2 recapturing on c2. The current position is in check? No, in_check false; Black's last move d4d3 threatened dxc2. Verifying a5b6 with the reserved 2000 nodes at full depth will confirm it is commit-ready and safe against immediate mates/checks.
